title: CISA shortens the deadline for US agencies to fix the most critical vulnerabilities in their networks to three days, citing hackers' use of AI (Raphael Satter/Reuters)
summary: Raphael Satter / Reuters: CISA shortens the deadline for US agencies to fix the most critical vulnerabilities in their networks to three days, citing hackers' use of AI — The U.S. cyber defense agency said on Wednesday that government officials now have three days to deal with the most serious categories …
